fieldValues.title: Themes L1
fieldValues.extension_adds: A visual presentation layer for `Composition`: brand identity, typography, stylesheets, cover pages, and element wrapping attached to a rendered document without altering its semantic structure. Requires `ext:views-l2`, whose document-level assembly it visually layers atop.
fieldValues.extension_cost_of_non_adoption: Without it, `Composition.themeRef` and `Composition.themeVariants` must be ignored rather than applied — an implementation renders a document's semantic structure with no brand identity, typography, stylesheet, cover page, or element-wrapping layer on top of it.
